symptom.statement: Capture of specific Reevalua/Finanty URLs fails with WEB_FETCH_CACHE_MISS on web.run open(url); EKB WEB-001 records frequency 46 between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-01 and lf_url_queue holds 39 FALLIDO rows (reevalua.com 34 of 236 rows, 32 of them under /blog/ where 89 other /blog/ rows were PROCESADO).

immediate_cause.statement: The external fetch/cache dependency does not return content for specific URLs in a given execution (URL-specific, not domain-wide: the same /blog/ section has 89 PROCESADO and 32 FALLIDO rows), and the pipeline correctly closes those URLs fail-closed.

systemic_root_cause.statement: The retry that EKB WEB-001 declares ('reintento posterior controlado') has no machine-checkable contract: the queue records the failure cause only as free text in error_detail (15 distinct groups across the FALLIDO/DESCARTADO rows, mixing cache miss, HTTP 500/timeout, non-retryable safe-open block, HITL and lifecycle errors), so retry eligibility, attempt cap and run lineage cannot be enforced or measured and every re-attempt of an unrecoverable URL is re-recorded as a new occurrence.

causal_chain.statement: A valid URL is queued and web.run open(url) returns Cache miss / 500 / timeout for it.

The orchestrator closes the URL as FALLIDO with a free-text error_detail and increments intento_count (26 rows at 1, 7 at 2, 6 at 3), without a typed failure class that says whether the URL may be retried.

Because retry eligibility is not typed, later runs re-attempt and re-document the same class, and the EKB entry accumulates occurrences (frequency 46) while 19 of 39 FALLIDO queue rows have no pipeline_run_id link to their FAILED run.

first_bad_control.statement: The failure-recording contract of the capture stage (lf_url_queue.error_detail plus the queue-to-run link) is untyped: it does not carry a retryability class or a mandatory pipeline_run_id at the moment the URL is closed FALLIDO.

escape_control.statement: The EKB WEB-001 validation (queue FALLIDO + FAILED run + no KB from non-existent content) detects harm but not retry waste or missing lineage; it passes (0 KB rows for 39 FALLIDO urls) while 19 FALLIDO rows lack the run link.

recurrence_evidence.fact: EKB WEB-001 frequency 46, first_vez 2026-08-24, ultima_vez 2026-09-01, recurrences appended on 2026-08-25, 08-26, 08-27 and 09-01.

derivation.criterion: lf_activos.owner_name of ACT-0058 is NULL (as for sibling skills ACT-0054..ACT-0057). Proposed value = owner_name of the most recent earlier lf_activos row of the same tipo_activo (SKILL), i.e. the current convention LF_GOVERNANCE (SKILL-GENERACION-PDF-PROFESIONAL-LF, 2026-09-23). Measured by hiding each owned row in turn and predicting it from earlier rows only: same-type rule 136 of 171 (0.795), any-type rule 157 of 192 (0.818); confidence is capped at the lower rate, 0.79. Since 2026-09-01, 76 of 106 owned rows use exactly LF_GOVERNANCE. The convention changed over time (Cristhian before 2026-06-10, LF_GOVERNANCE from 2026-09-23) and the current one is followed.
